**STEP 1 - Scene:** A cafeteria or airline-style tray meal with several dishes, photographed from the front at a slightly elevated angle on a white tablecloth.

**STEP 2 - Ruler:** The bottom pasta plate is about 22 cm across, so its area is about 380 cm². I use this as the scale reference. The small bowls are about 15 cm (177 cm²) and the vegetable plate is about 20 cm (314 cm²).

**STEP 3 - Items:** Noodles, baked pasta roll (lasagna or cannelloni style), stir-fried meat with broccoli, mixed vegetables (carrot, corn, broccoli), cut melon and papaya, orange juice, water, and a dark liquid in a glass bottle.

**STEP 4 - Area:** Noodles cover about 50% of the plate (190 cm²). Pasta roll covers about 60% of its plate (about 190 cm²). Stir-fry covers about 60% of its bowl (about 106 cm²). Vegetables cover about 35% of their plate (about 110 cm²). Fruit covers about 50% of its bowl (about 88 cm²).
